parameters.help_en: The token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This field is returned only when the RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

AuthAction.description_en: The unauthorized operation that was attempted
AuthAction.description_zh: 尝试执行的未授权操作

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorization principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the authorization principal owner

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The reason for the authentication failure. Valid values:
ExplicitDeny: explicit deny.
ImplicitDeny: implicit deny
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝

DingtalkNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether DingTalk alert notifications are configured. Valid values:

true: Configured. When an alert event occurs, a DingTalk notification is sent.

false: Not configured
DingtalkNotice.description_zh:
是否配置钉钉报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送钉钉通知

false：未配置

EmailNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether email alert notifications are configured. Valid values:

true: Configured. When an alert event occurs, an email notification is sent.

false: Not configured
EmailNotice.description_zh:
是否配置邮件报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送钉钉通知

false：未配置

NoticeType.description_en:
The alert event type:

Identity certificate is about to expire
Server certificate is about to expire
Certificate has expired
Certificate has been revoked
NoticeType.description_zh:
报警事件类型：

身份证书即将过期
服务器证书即将过期
证书已过期
证书被注销

SmsNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether SMS alert notifications are configured. Valid values:

true: Configured. When an alert event occurs, an SMS notification is sent.

false: Not configured.

SMS notifications are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and are not supported on the China site (Chinese mainland)
SmsNotice.description_zh:
是否配置短信报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送短信通知

false：未配置

仅中国站支持短信通知，国际站不支持短信通知
